sentences.englishText: William Shakespeare was born in Stratford in 1564 and moved to London to become an actor.
sentences.turkishText: William Shakespeare 1564'te Stratford'da doğdu ve oyuncu olmak için Londra'ya taşındı.

sentences.englishText: He wrote many famous plays like Romeo and Juliet and performed at the Globe Theatre.
sentences.turkishText: Romeo ve Juliet gibi birçok ünlü oyun yazdı ve Globe Tiyatrosu'nda sahne aldı.

sentences.englishText: Shakespeare died on his birthday in 1616 after returning to Stratford to live with his family.
sentences.turkishText: Shakespeare, ailesiyle yaşamak için Stratford'a döndükten sonra 1616'da doğum gününde öldü.

enrichment.summary: William Shakespeare was born in Stratford in 1564 and moved to London to become an actor. He wrote many famous plays like Romeo and Juliet and performed at the Globe Theatre.
